- India’s first integrated fun destination offering amusement cum water park, snow park, cable car and resort at a strategic tourist location
- Established track record with over two and a half decades of market presence and brand recognition
- Experienced promoters and dedicated senior management team with industry knowledge
- Strong institutional marketing and regional sales network
- High safety and hygiene standards
bull_bear.title: Bull — competitive strengths

bull_bear.body:
- We have a large number of personnel deployed across our amusement cum water theme park and snow park; consequently, we may be exposed to service-related claims and losses or employee disruptions that could have an adverse effect on our reputation, business, results of operations, financial condition, and cash flows.
- For instance, we owe the majority of our new customers to our marketing team, which undertakes several direct and indirect marketing techniques as well as franchise engagement to attract new customers to our amusement park and snow parks.
- Further, although we have not experienced any labour unrest in the last three Fiscals, we cannot assure you that we will not experience disruptions in work due to disputes or other problems with our workforce, which may adversely affect our ability to continue our business operations.
- A significant portion of our visitors are groups of school children to whom we offer various price incentives in order for them to visit, and they also tend to be more financially sensitive to economic fluctuations compared to larger institutional or corporate clients.
- Although Kerala’s economy has historically exhibited strong consumerism, resulting in steady household spending capacity, particularly on discretionary and lifestyle-related expenditures, periods of economic uncertainty, marked by inflation, rising unemployment, reduced consumer credit, or overall economic slowdown, can negatively impact consumer sentiment and lead to reduced spending on non-essential leisure activities, thereby affecting our Footfalls and revenue.
- We are dependent on third-party suppliers, transportation providers and vendors, and any disruption, delay or increase in costs could adversely affect our business, results of operations and financial condition.
- Our Athirappilly Theme Park is located in a relatively remote area of Thrissur, which increases our reliance on third-party suppliers and transportation providers for the timely delivery of spare parts, safety and maintenance equipment, food and beverage items, and other consumables.
- The distance from major urban centres and supply hubs can result in longer lead times, higher transportation costs, and greater susceptibility to delays arising from logistical constraints, fuel price fluctuations, road conditions, labour shortages, or supply chain disruptions.

drhp.one_liner: We provide special schemes for bulk bookings made in advance by educational institutions and by corporate customers.
risks: We have a large number of personnel deployed across our amusement cum water theme park and snow park; consequently, we may be exposed to service-related claims and losses or employee disruptions that could have an adverse effect on our reputation, business, results of operations, financial condition, and cash flows.

For instance, we owe the majority of our new customers to our marketing team, which undertakes several direct and indirect marketing techniques as well as franchise engagement to attract new customers to our amusement park and snow parks.

Further, although we have not experienced any labour unrest in the last three Fiscals, we cannot assure you that we will not experience disruptions in work due to disputes or other problems with our workforce, which may adversely affect our ability to continue our business operations.

A significant portion of our visitors are groups of school children to whom we offer various price incentives in order for them to visit, and they also tend to be more financially sensitive to economic fluctuations compared to larger institutional or corporate clients.

Although Kerala’s economy has historically exhibited strong consumerism, resulting in steady household spending capacity, particularly on discretionary and lifestyle-related expenditures, periods of economic uncertainty, marked by inflation, rising unemployment, reduced consumer credit, or overall economic slowdown, can negatively impact consumer sentiment and lead to reduced spending on non-essential leisure activities, thereby affecting our Footfalls and revenue.

We are dependent on third-party suppliers, transportation providers and vendors, and any disruption, delay or increase in costs could adversely affect our business, results of operations and financial condition.

Our Athirappilly Theme Park is located in a relatively remote area of Thrissur, which increases our reliance on third-party suppliers and transportation providers for the timely delivery of spare parts, safety and maintenance equipment, food and beverage items, and other consumables.

The distance from major urban centres and supply hubs can result in longer lead times, higher transportation costs, and greater susceptibility to delays arising from logistical constraints, fuel price fluctuations, road conditions, labour shortages, or supply chain disruptions.

other_material_facts.label: material fact
other_material_facts.value: OUR BUSINESS SEGMENT We operate an integrated leisure and entertainment destination at Athirappilly, Kerala under the brand ‘Silver Storm’, comprising an amusement cum water park, snow park, and a resort facility, with an upcoming ropeway cable car attraction under development and a snow park at Jamshedpur, Jharkhand under the brand “Snow Storm”.

other_material_facts.label: material fact
other_material_facts.value: Restaurant We operate a thoughtfully designed F&B services at our Athirappilly Theme Park which is designed to cater to park visitors, resort guests and the general public.

other_material_facts.label: material fact
other_material_facts.value: 203 Strategically positioned adjacent to the State Highway, this restaurant serves a dual purpose: (i) Public Access - It caters to the general public and highway commuters, independent of park entry; and (ii) Integration with Snow Storm - It addresses the previously underserved F&B requirements of visitors to Snow Storm, who do not have access to the primary in-park restaurant and outlets. (iii) Athirappilly waterfalls restaurant and booking office We operate a standalone facility adjacent to the Athirappilly waterfalls, which integrates a restaurant with a satellite ticket booking office.

other_material_facts.label: material fact
other_material_facts.value: We provide special schemes for bulk bookings made in advance by educational institutions and by corporate customers.

other_material_facts.label: certifications
other_material_facts.value: OVERVIEW We are an ISO 9001:2015 certified integrated amusement destination with an amusement cum water park, a snow park, an integrated resort and an upcoming aerial cable car project near Athirappilly waterfalls in Thrissur, Kerala (“Athirappilly Theme Park”).

other_material_facts.label: vertical_integration
other_material_facts.value: They are supported by an in-house team for sales, marketing and a team for new projects which includes a team of 46 people, which makes us self-reliant on all critical aspects of our business.

other_material_facts.label: scale
other_material_facts.value: Our Athirappilly Theme Park is strategically located in midst of lush green forest area of western ghats in Thrissur district of Kerala and nearby scenic Athirappilly waterfalls, largest waterfall in Kerala and Vazhachal waterfalls, a prominent tourist destination in Kerala.

other_material_facts.label: repeat_business
other_material_facts.value: This resort facility has allowed the Company to tap into the growing trend of short-stay leisure travel and staycations, contributing to improved customer retention and longer visitor engagement periods.

other_material_facts.label: vertical_integration
other_material_facts.value: The Company has deployed a dedicated in-house sales and marketing team comprising of 46 personnel, who regularly covers all major districts in Kerala and nearby urban center of Tamil Nadu, including Coimbatore, Erode, Tirupur, Namakkal, Madurai, Dindigul, Karur, Nilgiris and Selam for various marketing activities.

other_material_facts.label: certifications
other_material_facts.value: Our Athirappilly Theme Park have been certified with ISO 9001:2015 by ARS Assessment Private Limited for amusement rides, water slides, snow park and resort.

other_material_facts.label: technology_ip
other_material_facts.value: For our water-based attractions, we use reverse osmosis technology to ensure that the water is potable, clean and safe.

other_material_facts.label: cost_advantage
other_material_facts.value: Our strength lies in our ability to continuously identify and add new attractions in our amusement park as well as manage capital expenditure within the budget and in a cost-effective manner.

other_material_facts.label: scale
other_material_facts.value: In the Indian amusement park market, South India consistently leads in market share, projected to reach Rs 58.8 billion by CY29, registering a CAGR of 16% during CY25P to CY29P.

other_material_facts.label: vertical_integration
other_material_facts.value: By offering in-house lodging, we are able to target tourists, corporate groups, and educational institutions for overnight programs, family vacations, and bundled tour packages.

other_material_facts.value: HEALTH AND SAFETY STANDARDS Park security and safety are key priorities for us, built on our three core principles: a proactive approach, an optimal mix of technology and manpower, and adherence to internationally accepted safety standards.

other_material_facts.value: Ride installation, commissioning and trials: Prior to commissioning any new ride or attraction for public use, the Company conducts a comprehensive series of trial runs in the presence of manufacturer/supply engineers.

other_material_facts.label: customer_qualification
other_material_facts.value: The scope and duration of these trials are as follows: • Empty Load Trial: Performed at slow speeds for a duration of 8 hours. • Partial Load Trial: Conducted using sandbags for 12 hours. • Full Load/Full Speed Trial: Conducted using sandbags at maximum operating speed for 24 hours. • Operational Trial: Final trial runs are conducted with trained operators before public use.

other_material_facts.label: customer_qualification
other_material_facts.value: Prior to operation, daily monitoring is confirmed and trial runs undertaken by senior technicians.

other_material_facts.label: lock_in
other_material_facts.value: Inscription or recording of non-transferability In terms of Regulation 241 of the SEBI ICDR Regulations, our Company confirms that certificates of Equity Shares which are subject to lock in shall contain the inscription “Non-Transferable” and specify the lock-in period and in case such equity shares are dematerialized, the Company shall ensure that the lock-in is recorded by the Depository. 25.

other_material_facts.label: lock_in
other_material_facts.value: Pledge of Locked in Equity Shares In terms of Regulation 242 of the SEBI ICDR Regulations, the locked in Equity Shares held by the Promoters, as specified above, can be pledged with any scheduled commercial bank or public financial institution or a systemically important non-banking finance company or a housing finance company as collateral security for loan granted by such bank or institution provided that the pledge of Equity Shares is one of the terms of the sanction of the loan.

other_material_facts.label: lock_in
other_material_facts.value: Provided that securities locked in as Minimum Promoter’s Contribution may be pledged only if, in addition to fulfilling the above requirements, the loan has been granted by such bank or institution, for the purpose of financing one or more of the objects of the Issue.

other_material_facts.label: lock_in
other_material_facts.value: However, lock in shall continue pursuant to the invocation of the pledge and such transferee shall not be eligible to transfer the equity shares till the lock in period stipulated has expired. 26.

other_material_facts.label: lock_in
other_material_facts.value: Transferability of Locked in Equity Shares In terms of Regulation 243 of the SEBI ICDR Regulations and subject to provisions of Securities and Exchange Board of India (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 as applicable: The Equity Shares held by our Promoters and locked in as per Regulation 238 of the SEBI ICDR Regulations may be transferred to any person of the Promoters’ Group or to a new promoter(s) or persons in control of our Company, subject to continuation of lock-in for the remaining period with transferee and such transferee shall not be eligible to transfer them till the lock-in period stipulated has expired.

other_material_facts.label: lock_in
other_material_facts.value: The Equity Shares held by persons other than Promoters and locked in as per Regulation 239 of the SEBI ICDR Regulations may be transferred to any other person (including Promoters’ Group) holding the equity shares which are locked-in along with the equity shares proposed to be transferred, subject to continuation of lock-in for the remaining period with transferee and such transferee shall not be eligible to transfer them till the lock in period stipulated has expired. 27.

other_material_facts.label: material fact
other_material_facts.value: Restaurant We operate a thoughtfully designed F&B services at our Athirappilly Theme Park which is designed to cater to park visitors, resort guests and the general public.

other_material_facts.label: material fact
other_material_facts.value: 203 Strategically positioned adjacent to the State Highway, this restaurant serves a dual purpose: (i) Public Access - It caters to the general public and highway commuters, independent of park entry; and (ii) Integration with Snow Storm - It addresses the previously underserved F&B requirements of visitors to Snow Storm, who do not have access to the primary in-park restaurant and outlets. Any potential investor in, and purchaser of, the Equity Shares should pay particular attention to the fact that our Company is an Indian company and is subject to a legal and regulatory environment which, in some respects, may be different from that which prevails in other countries.

Although we have a comprehensive in-house team for maintenance and management of our amusement park and snow parks, any unexpected accident, malfunction or mechanical breakdown of machinery at our amusement park and snow parks could disrupt operations, result in increased maintenance or replacement costs, and adversely affect our business, financial condition, and results of operations.

financial_valuation.risk: Additional risks and uncertainties, not presently known to us or that we currently deem immaterial may also impair our business, cash flows, prospects, results of operations and financial condition.

If any of the risks described below, or other risks that are not currently known or are currently deemed immaterial actually occur, our business, cash flows, prospects, results of operations and financial condition could be adversely affected, the trading price of the Equity Shares could decline, and investors may lose all or part of the value of their investment.

As a result, lower-than-expected Footfalls during certain quarters or more pronounced seasonal variations in attendance could disproportionately impact our revenues, operating results, and cash flows.

internal_operational.risk: We have a large number of personnel deployed across our amusement cum water theme park and snow park; consequently, we may be exposed to service-related claims and losses or employee disruptions that could have an adverse effect on our reputation, business, results of operations, financial condition, and cash flows.

For instance, we owe the majority of our new customers to our marketing team, which undertakes several direct and indirect marketing techniques as well as franchise engagement to attract new customers to our amusement park and snow parks.

Further, although we have not experienced any labour unrest in the last three Fiscals, we cannot assure you that we will not experience disruptions in work due to disputes or other problems with our workforce, which may adversely affect our ability to continue our business operations.

strategy_growth.risk: Since our primary operations are concentrated to one amusement cum water theme park and geographical area currently, our business operations are vulnerable to damage or interruptions in operations due to adverse weather conditions, earthquakes, fires, explosions, power loss, transmission cable cuts, civil disturbances or other similar events which may affect these areas.

Although we have now expanded our business to Jamshedpur, Jharkhand, by opening a snow park which is already in operation, and intend to open a snow park and family entertainment centre in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh as well, so as to diversify our portfolio and decrease geographical dependence.

Our future growth also depends on our ability to increase Footfalls at our existing amusement park and snow parks, penetrate deeper into existing and new geographic locations, and increase revenue from other revenue streams, our inability to do so could adversely and materially affect our growth Our growth is significantly dependent on increasing Footfalls at our existing amusement park and snow parks, enhancing penetration in the existing and new geographies, and diversifying into other revenue streams.
